title: JW Marriott Desert Springs Resort & Spa
description: 450-acre full-service resort in Palm Desert with two championship golf courses, 230,000+ sq ft of meeting and event space, 13 tennis courts, a 38,000 sq ft spa, and gondola waterways through the lobby.
agent_summary: JW Marriott Desert Springs Resort & Spa is a 450-acre Marriott property at 74-855 Country Club Drive, Palm Desert, with 230,000+ sq ft of meeting space, two championship golf courses, and full Marriott Bonvoy booking access — the valley's largest conference-capable resort.
